# Smart wake (spec 02 §9): the paused game waits for one of its players per side; if a new game
# starts first, it stays in the paused games list.
config guest=1 first_ball=home pause=5m sleep=3m on_wake=smart
next official
coin home 04000007 player=7
coin away 04000003 player=3
wait 5s
expect phase playing                                  # game 1: 7 against 3
sensor home_goal
wait 5m
expect phase sleeping
expect recent 1
ejected home
ejected away

# Other players are quicker: the countdown runs out before 7 is back.
coin home 04000009 player=9
coin away 04000003 player=3                           # one side of game 1 is back …
expect phase pregame
wait 5s
expect phase playing                                  # … but game 2 (9 against 3) started first
expect started_by system
expect recent none
expect status 1 paused
coin home 04000007 player=7                           # too late: game 1 stays in the list
expect status 1 paused
expect roster home=9,7 away=3,_

# "Start new game" while the same players are registered: no smart resume (only after a wake).
sensor home_goal
start official                                        # game 2 → paused list
expect status 2 paused
expect phase pregame
wait 5s
expect phase playing                                  # game 3, not game 2
expect status 2 paused
